description: This file defines the AndroidMavenUtil class, providing utility methods for handling Maven dependencies and modules within an Android project, including path computations, module naming, and dependency type checks.

classes.name: AndroidMavenUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing Maven dependencies and modules in Android projects.

methods.name: computePathForGenExternalApklibsDir
methods.description: Computes the directory path for external APK libraries based on Maven dependencies and project structure.

methods.name: getGenExternalApklibDirInProject
methods.description: Returns the path to the gen-external-apklibs directory within a given Maven project.

methods.name: containsCompileDependency
methods.description: Checks if a collection of Maven artifacts contains a dependency with 'compile' scope.

methods.name: getModuleNameForExtApklibArtifact
methods.description: Generates a module name for an external APK library artifact based on its MavenId.

methods.name: getMavenIdStringByExtApklibModule
methods.description: Extracts the MavenId string from a module name if it is an external APK library module.

methods.name: isExtApklibModule
methods.description: Determines if a module is an external APK library module based on its name.

methods.name: getMavenIdStringForFileName
methods.description: Converts a MavenId into a filename-safe string.

methods.name: isMavenizedModule
methods.description: Checks if a module is Maven-enabled.

methods.name: isMavenAarDependency
methods.description: Determines if an order entry in a module corresponds to a Maven AAR dependency.
